Done. Here's the summary:

## Applied — $23,325.50 (3 entries, all supported)

All in the US entity; UK and DE had nil Unapplied Cash balances, so there was nothing to do there.

| Entry | Customer | Amount | Applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00312 | Beacon Health | $9,600.00 | INV-1041 ($4,350) + INV-1047 ($5,250) |
| JE-00313 | Corvid Retail | $8,450.00 | INV-1044 |
| JE-00314 | Dunmore Foods | $5,275.50 | INV-1049 |

Each one traces to a remittance advice and ties **exactly** to the deposit. I confirmed every referenced invoice was genuinely still open (booked to AR with no prior receipt against it) rather than just matching on amount. All three are under the $10k posting limit, so no approval request was needed.

## Left in Unapplied Cash — $3,000.00

**Evergreen Bank, 2026-03-23 (JE-00291)** — flagged as EXC-001.

This one I couldn't apply, and I don't think it should be forced:
- No remittance advice exists for it.
- Evergreen has **no open invoice**. Its only three 2026 invoices (Jan/Feb/Mar, $6,200 each) were each paid in full and separately — the March one was already settled on 3/20, three days *before* this deposit landed.
- $3,000 doesn't equal or cleanly partial-pay any invoice, so there's no defensible allocation.

Most likely an overpayment, a prepayment against an April invoice, or a payer misidentified by the bank feed. Worth having AR chase Evergreen for remittance detail.

2950 (US) went from $26,325.50 to $3,000.00 credit, and the residual now agrees exactly to that single open item.

## One thing to flag for your awareness

All four original deposits were posted by the bank feed **without support attached**, and they're still unmatched on the bank-rec side. My application entries carry the remittance support, but the underlying feed postings remain unsupported and unreconciled. Bank reconciliation is its own open checklist item, so I left that alone rather than half-finish it — but you may want it picked up alongside this. I didn't change any checklist statuses.
